verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows 1Password offering a self-hostable sync server that keeps all secrets inside the customer's perimeter. Connect Servers give apps and infrastructure private REST API access to 1Password items and vaults. That is an adjacent integration component, not a self-hosted sync backend. Community reports also describe self-hosting and local vaults as lost options.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter
